mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate indicates a robust demand environment, which drives up equity prices and results in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the federal funds rate triggers an increase in borrowing and spending, leading to higher equity prices and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate indicates a strong labor market, which drives up consumer spending and results in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of low unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production indicates a strong supply environment, which drives up equity prices and results in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of high industrial production (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between GDP growth rate and housing starts indicates a robust demand environment, which drives up equity prices and results in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth and high housing starts (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between the federal funds rate and inflation rate indicates a monetary environment that drives up equity prices and results in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A high payroll employment level indicates a strong labor market, which drives up consumer spending and results in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but only during periods of low unemployment.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of high payroll employment and low unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between GDP growth rate, housing starts, and consumer spending indicates a robust demand environment, which drives up equity prices and results in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during periods of strong economic growth.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth, high housing starts, and high consumer spending (t-test p > 0.05).
